dates.title: Event dates
dates.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.

cards.rankHint: Rank is your state rank. Alliance is your alliance rank.
cards.battleNote: Battle score and rank are their own result. They are not added to Days 1 to 5.

overall.title: Overall result
overall.hint: Locking keeps a number from changing while you play on. Locked numbers can be unlocked.

end.title: End {event} and save it to history?
end.noRanks: Overall rank and alliance rank are empty.
end.unlocked: {count, plural, one {{amount} day is not locked.} other {{amount} days are not locked.}} They are saved as entered, and days with no numbers stay empty.
end.saves: Saves the dates, the daily scores and ranks, and the overall result to History, with the planned total of each day.
end.clearsCounts: Clears the counts for every day, so every day of the plan starts at 0.
end.clearsPlans: Clears the plans exported to this event and the checklist checks.
end.keeps: Only this event is cleared. Your goals and plans on other pages stay.
end.toastMessage: {event} is saved to History. The event starts new with no dates.

history.intro: {event} events you ended, newest first. Ending an event saves its log here and cannot be edited later, only removed. <link>Open History for plan against actual and planned upgrades.</link>
history.empty: No ended events yet. End an event to save its log here.

checklist.title: Plan checklist
checklist.castleTitle: Sign up for a Castle position for {day}
checklist.castleBody: Castle positions give bonuses for the next day. Sign up before today ends so the bonus is on for {day}.
checklist.planLine: Plan for the day: {points} points. Only actions with a count above 0 are listed. Counts come from the Core events page.
checklist.empty: No action has a count for this day. Add counts on the Core events page.
checklist.resourcesHint: Items the day spends. Check your stock before you start.
